adjudication.rationale: The diff adds two new gems to `Gemfile` but only updates `Gemfile_rails4.lock`. There is no corresponding update to the default lockfile (`Gemfile.lock`) in this diff, so in any setup that uses the standard Bundler workflow (Gemfile + Gemfile.lock, especially with `--deployment`/frozen settings), the lockfile would be out of sync with the Gemfile and bundler would fail or refuse to install. The diff itself shows the mismatch (Gemfile changed, only rails4 lock updated).
